name: Darren Maher
bio: hi, i’m darren, i’m {age}, i dropped out of my software engineering course after the first year in pursuit of building great things; i feel startups are one of the best vehicles for making change in the world.
now working at meta-flux, a dublin biotechnology company.
in my free time i love writing music, sports, reading, and i’m also very interested in ancient greece at the minute.

books.title: On the Shortness of Life
books.author: Seneca
books.take: we often complain how short life is without making the most of what we have.

books.title: The Making of Prince of Persia
books.author: Jordan Mechner
books.take: a game built on an apple ii, great insight into what it’s like to build something from the ground up.

books.title: Shoe Dog
books.author: Phil Knight
books.take: started selling shoes out of a car boot; great things take time.

books.title: Nineteen Eighty-Four
books.author: George Orwell
books.take: one of my favourite books, somehow gets more relevant every year.

books.title: Zero to One
books.author: Peter Thiel
books.take: competition is for losers, tough point to argue with.

books.title: Dubliners
books.author: James Joyce
books.take: one of joyce’s easier books, reading it made me realise on a generational level humans never really change.

books.title: Normal People
books.author: Sally Rooney
books.take: 10/10 book, however it is emotionally devastating and i wouldn’t recommend it to anyone.

books.title: The Bell Jar
books.author: Sylvia Plath
books.take: funnier than i expected, right up until it isn’t.

books.title: The Big Short
books.author: Michael Lewis
books.take: significantly better than the movie, i too was flabbergasted.
